Henrik Vadmann is a consultant physician (*afdelingslæge*) at Regionshospitalet Nordjylland, located in the North Denmark Region (*Region Nordjylland*) [^src1]. He serves as a member of the [[afdk-styregruppe|Styregruppen for AFDK]], the steering group responsible for overseeing the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database [^src1]. His participation in this group ensures regional medical representation from the North Denmark Region within a national framework dedicated to quality measurement and clinical development in the Danish healthcare system [^src1]. The steering group comprises a broad base of professionals and patient representatives who guide critical analyses on clinical outcomes—such as the incidence of ischemic stroke and intracranial hemorrhage—as well as treatment practices like anticoagulation wait times for atrial fibrillation patients across Denmark [^src1].
